purpose: Descriptive evidence audit, not a new entry gate or economic test
sample: Exactly old 33 events / 32 entry-day raw sources; NOACT14 and PRICE19 separate; no new cases or outcome relabeling
prefix: First four provider labels 09:35,09:40,09:45,09:50; fixed because 09:50 was earliest evaluation of both existing rules, not chosen by a new window search
facts: Raw closes relative to initial raw open then prior close give U/D/F sign sequence; raw OHLCVA and volume fractions retained. No sign sequence is used to authorize or reject an order.
timing: Provider labels and ordering only. Completed/publication/available_at and auction coverage UNKNOWN. No certified real-time trade eligibility.
known_development: Prior labels and source reports were known; initial vectors had been inspected. Not preregistration, blind validation or OOS.
quality: Exact Decimal per-bar OHLC, positive volume, nonnegative amount and L*V<=A<=H*V on prefix only. Whole-day daily aggregation mismatch retained as later audit metadata, never prefix exclusion.
controls: 33 physical-prefix and 33 future poison checks; source hashes before/after. No parameter search, new data fetch, score/ranking, economic/account run, old file change or reconstructed fill.
decision: Determine whether observed sequence/volume evidence supports a defensible distinct candidate; do not repair ORB/VWAP by exceptions or stricter inequalities.
